claim.claim-text: 1. A marker for use in marking a biopsy site, the marker comprising:

a body, a sharp tip on the distal end of the body, wherein the sharp tip is configured to pierce tissue, an arm extending proximally and outwardly relative to the sharp tip, wherein the arm defines an inwardly oriented barb disposed on a proximal end of the arm.
2. The marker of claim 1, further comprising a base, wherein the base extends outwardly from the body.
3. The marker of claim 2, wherein the base extends outwardly from the body at a length at least equivalent to the outward extension of the arm.
4. The marker of claim 2, the base being configured to correspond to the mass of the arm to balance a trajectory of the marker during deployment.
5. The marker of claim 2, the base being a circular disk.
6. The marker of claim 2, the base including two outwardly extending protrusions.
7. The marker of claim 1, the barb being configured as a tooth extending laterally and inwardly relative to the outward extension of the arm.
8. The marker of claim 7, the barb being configured to partially pierce one or more tissue segments to thereby hold the marker in a fixed position within tissue.
9. The marker of claim 7, the barb including a sharp end.
10. The marker of claim 1, the marker further comprising a first arm and a second arm, the first arm being oriented at an angle relative to the second arm.
11. The marker of claim 10, the first arm and the second arm each including a respective barb.
12. The marker of claim 10, the first arm and the second arm being joined at the body to define an arrow-shaped configuration.
13. The marker of claim 1, The marker being configured as a bare marker.
14. The marker of claim 1, at least a portion of the marker being disposed within a carrier.
15. The marker of claim 1, further comprising a base, a first arm, and a second arm, the base extending outwardly from the body longitudinally offset relative to the first arm and the second arm,

the first arm and the second arm being joined at the body to define an arrow-shaped configuration, each of the first arm and the second arm including a respective first barb and second barb, the first barb and the second barb each being configured as a tooth extending laterally and inwardly relative to the outward extension of the respective first arm and second arm, each of the first barb and the second barb being configured to partially pierce one or more tissue segments to thereby hold the marker in a fixed position within tissue, the marker being configured as a bare marker.
